newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine reserves not released for 4th day in row.
newsitem.headline: Argentine reserves not released for 4th day in row.

text.p: Argentina's Central Bank did not announce its international reserve levels Friday, the fourth day in a row no figures have been announced.
A source at the bank said that computer problems meant they could not distribute the figures -- usually announced daily with a 48-hour delay -- but that they should be released Monday.
The last report on reserves was issued last Monday, when the bank reported it had $18.32 billion in reserves by September 26, of which $2.66 billion, or 14.28 percent, were in securities.
